summary: Quashing of ECIR/prosecution complaint under PMLA; petitioner's contention: buyer-seller transaction with no knowledge of proceeds of crime; reliance on Nikesh Tarachand Shah; absence in CBI FIR/ECIR; ED counter: specific allegations of money laundering based on investigation; prima facie case established under PMLA; quashing not warranted in routine cases; no abuse of process.
legal_provisions_cited: Prevention of Money Laundering Act, 2002 s.3, s.4, s.2(1)(u)
Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988 s.13(1)(d), s.13(2)
final_judgment: High Court's dismissal of quashing petitions upheld; ED prosecution complaint allowed to proceed.
